businessMeaning: Finer pitch raises bandwidth density but tightens alignment and cleanliness requirements, shifting cost into bonding and inspection.
investmentLens: Bonders, inspection and substrates capture the value; customers should expect qualification cycles to stretch as pitch shrinks.
